hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launch pools (native ETH / TOKEN) with LP fee set to 0. The hook intercepts swaps to collect an ETH-denominated fee (set at pool registration, up to 5%), then instantly distributes it to a platform wallet and per-pool recipients, with the remainder routed to one of several reserve modes: buyback-and-burn, stock rewards, robin staking, lottery, or liquidity provision.
